subject: Apply theme changes immediately, no restart required
body:
Apply theme changes immediately, no restart required

ThemePage.SaveSettings() previously just persisted ThemeName and
showed a "restart required" dialog. ThemeManager.ActiveTheme's setter
already persists ThemeName and raises ThemeChanged, which every themed
form/control is subscribed to - so assigning it is sufficient to
re-theme the running application immediately.

triage.rationale: Our fork already supports live theme changes immediately without requiring a restart, making this change redundant.
